Name: Biyoo Buddy
Author: BricBrock
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]This is a mod I made following [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/SiTheGreat1]SiTheGreat1[/url]'s wonderful "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43811?tab=description]Modder's Pie[/url]" tutorial. This is my first mod! It adds Biyoo as an item! At the moment, she has no function other than being placed, but I plan to make her help you with quests! (If I can figure that out, otherwise she's just cute, decorative pocket lint).[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]She may or may not be added to a future mod I'm thinking of... But that's a ways away still.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Ensure you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] installed[/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Unzip the mod folder[/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Move the unzipped "[CP] Biyoo Buddy" folder to your "mods" folder (Steam/steamapps/common/Stardew Valley/mods)[/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Enjoy![/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=3](If you're left with a loose "[CP] Biyoo Buddy.zip", you're free to delete it, as it serves no purpose now)[/size][/color][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Biyoo is now a craftable item! For the moment, her recipe is unlocked by default.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]She can be placed! (But not picked up again because I didn't even mean for her to be place-able and have no idea why or how she is and have yet to figure out how to let the player pick her up again.) (I will happily take any help I can if anyone has ideas...)[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]She looks cute?[/color][/size][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]This is a[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915] Content Patcher[/url] mod and depends on Content Patcher 2.4+ to run.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Thank you again to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/SiTheGreat1]SiTheGreat1[/url] for the tutorial. It was so, so helpful in trying to orient myself. Jumping into mod-making feels much less intimidating now![/color][/size]

Manifest.Name: (CP) Biyoo Buddy
Manifest.Description: Adds Biyoo to the game as a craftable item.
Manifest.Author: BricBrock
